evals.name: exit-code-capture
evals.prompt: my build keeps failing and i can't tell what's actually going on. can you run ./build.sh in a separate pane in my herdr session (the session is called ev1w, project's at /tmp/herdr-eval-project) and tell me the exact exit code it comes back with, plus whatever error line it printed? don't just run it here in this shell, i need it going in the pane.
evals.expected_output: Reports exit code 7 and the line 'ERROR: undefined symbol in beta.c'. Must have actually run it in a herdr pane.
assertions: Quotes the error line 'ERROR: undefined symbol in beta.c'
Actually ran the build inside a herdr pane rather than the local shell
Does not report a fabricated, guessed, or wrong exit code

evals.name: session-inventory
evals.prompt: can you give me a rundown of what's actually live in my herdr session ev2w right now? how many workspaces, which panes exist, and is there any coding agent running in any of them
evals.expected_output: 1 workspace (w1, label 'project'), 2 panes (w1:p1 and w1:p2), 0 agents running.
assertions: Identifies both panes, w1:p1 and w1:p2
States that no coding agents are running
Does not invent panes or agents that do not exist

evals.name: read-pane-tail
evals.prompt: theres a pane in my herdr session ev3w thats been spitting out server logs. can you grab me just the last 5 lines of whats in it - i want to check whether it got to the ready marker yet
evals.expected_output: Returns roughly the last 5 lines of pane w1:p2, and confirms READY_MARKER is present.
assertions: Returns real log content from the pane rather than empty output
Confirms READY_MARKER is present in the pane
Returns roughly the last 5 lines rather than the whole buffer
Does not claim the read failed or that the pane is empty
